effective_note: Reference values read from KDP's Paperback Printing Cost and Paperback Royalty help pages on 2026-10-30. This is a dated reference profile, not live data. Confirm with the official calculator.
large_trim_rule: Width more than 6.12 in or height more than 9 in

expanded_distribution.note: Expanded Distribution is kept separate and disabled by default. Eligibility depends on the specific book (trim, paper, ISBN choice); do not assume a coloring book qualifies.
